coaching: At 00:29 Ed went straight to questions and the call became Q&A. Set an upfront contract (time, purpose, OK to say no, what happens at the end) and use reversing: 'Great question. Before I answer, what's behind it?'

Ed keeps talking about 'they' and 'people', which suggests he may be advising clients. Find out whether he is investing himself or referring clients, who decides, and why he is looking. He offered '250 or a hundred'. Confirm the amount, source (IRA was mentioned) and timing.
At 11:28 Ed said 'I'll be back in contact' and it was accepted. Book a dated follow-up after his weekend review. Also describe 5-7 years as a target, not a promise that capital and pref will be paid.
